messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT detected: Canary rollout for model 'redwood/gpt-3x' (canary: gpt-3x-int8) showing sustained latency and 5xx increase in us-east-1. Sticky fallback engaged to variant 'gpt-3x-legacy' and now we are seeing routing oscillation across regions. Pager opened: PD-2345

alex: oncall here, looking now. seeing p95 spike on the canary pool to ~7.9s, baseline 220ms. errors up ~6% in last 10m.

maria: noticed a pattern — requests that hit the canary often fall back to legacy, then get routed back to canary due to sticky route policy; cycle repeats when the canary returns partial success.

jordan: @alex @maria can you dump the rollout config? suspect variant mismatch.

eli_support: getting two customer escalations re: timeouts on embedding endpoints — they started ~11:08 UTC. customers A and B.

alex: grabbing rollout config from control-plane:```json
{"rollout_id":"rl-9921","target_model":"redwood/gpt-3x","canary":{"variant":"gpt-3x-int8","weight":0.1},"sticky_fallback":true,"fallback_variant":"gpt-3x-legacy"}```

maria: ah — operator intended canary variant to be `gpt-3x-fp16` but rollout references `gpt-3x-int8` (experimental). that int8 variant has known latency regressions on sequence lengths > 512.

eng_ops: logs from router show repeated sticky cookie set and removed:```text
[router] set_cookie=sticky_route=canary; ttl=600
[router] route=canary -> backend=eu-west-1->us-east-1->canary
[router] fallback to legacy (sticky)
[router] route=legacy -> backend=us-east-1
[router] detected oscillation: 64 loops in 5m
```

jordan: tagging incident priority P1 due to customer impact and oscillation causing load spikes. Paging escalation to SRE.

alex: mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout weight to 0 2) disable sticky_fallback 3) force route drain of canary sessions 4) flush KV cache on canary nodes 5) notify customers. I'm executing step 1 now.

maria: I'm flipping sticky_fallback false in policy UI (canary suspended). doing step 2.

eng_ops: confirm: rollout weight set to 0. Sticky disabled. Router config pushed:```
policy:
  canary_weight: 0
  sticky_fallback: false
```

eli_support: customers notified: "We're investigating increased latency; we've paused the canary and will follow up in 30m." they acknowledged.

alex: forcing drain on canary pool with:```bash
rctl drain-pool --pool canary-gpt-3x-int8 --grace 30
```

maria: flushing prefix KV: `redis-cli -h canary-kv FLUSHDB` (running on canary redis instances)

eng_ops: started graceful restart of canary routers to clear sticky cookies.

incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handoff scheduled: @alex -> @maria at +25m.

jordan: monitoring metrics. p95 for whole cluster dropping from 7.9s -> 420ms after the weight=0 and sticky disable. error rate returning to baseline.

eli_support: customer A reports reduced latencies, customer B still sees occasional timeouts (investigating whether they had long-lived sticky session).

maria: found one client with sticky cookie from 11:01 that kept hitting legacy until TTL expiry — we've invalidated that cookie server-side for that client id.

eng_ops: routing oscillation count down to 0. no new loops observed in last 8m.

alex: can we safely rollback canary to intended variant? options: (A) re-run canary with `gpt-3x-fp16` or (B) abort and re-audit release pipeline. prefer A but run smaller scope.

jordan: recommend abort full rollout and create new canary with explicit variant and rollout tests. we should not reuse int8.

maria: agree. creating rollback ticket and marking this canary as blocked in the console.

eli_support: final customer impact tally so far: 12 customers with degraded latencies, 3 customers with transient errors >5min. Support actions documented in the incident doc.

eng_ops: quick RCA notes: root cause = misconfigured canary variant (int8) + sticky_fallback=true + absence of a guardrail that prevents int8 variants for sequences >512. combined to cause oscillation and elevated load.

alex: actions: 1) require variant validation in rollout UI (disallow int8 for models with typical seq_len>512)
2) add an e2e test that simulates sticky_fallback + canary_failures to detect oscillation
3) add alert for "routing oscillation" metric (threshold 10 loops / 5m)
4) add rollback runbook steps to canary flow (one-click pause + global cookie invalidation)

maria: assigning owners: #1 product (maria), #2 eng-runtime (jordan), #3 eng-sre (alex), #4 devex (eli_support).

jordan: I'll prep a follow-up postmortem draft and share with infra and product.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Canary paused and routing stabilized. Root cause tagged. Postmortem in progress.

eli_support: closing PD incident ticket, will reopen if regressions.

maria: thanks team. I'll schedule a 1hr post-incident review tomorrow and link the draft.

alex: adding final note: we should sandbox int8 variants with stricter perf tests before any rollout. Good catch everyone. :heart:
